title: Benefits of Our Comfort Club Membership
desc: Rosenberg Indoor Comfort proudly serves San Antonio, TX and the surrounding areas. Contact us today to learn more about our Comfort Club Membership!

blocks.text: Heating and cooling your home or business is one of your biggest expenses, but being comfortable is a necessary expense. Fortunately, there are ways you can improve the efficiency of your heating and air conditioning system and save money at the same time.

Rosenberg Indoor Comfort offers a Comfort Club Membership which can help you with any parts and services you need throughout the year. As part of the membership, you will receive many benefits that will make sure your equipment to keep is in top shape.

During the spring and the fall, you will receive a precision tune-up of your entire heating and air conditioning system. A handy postcard will remind you, so you can stay on schedule. Our trained technicians will spend time going over all the parts, including:

Your technician will also check the temperature and pressure, and make sure your thermostat is calibrated properly. Your system’s carbon monoxide levels will be checked, as will your drains and electrical connections.

We stand behind our work, and any parts and labor you receive will have a full year’s warranty and your parts will automatically be discounted 15%. As a Comfort Club member, you will be able to call for emergency help any time of the day or night at discounted rates for “comfort on command.” First time Comfort Club members qualify for a discount, and you can get additional discounts if you have multiple HVAC systems.
How the Club Saves You Money

You are already saving money with the Club because the yearly membership fee is less than the price of the tune-ups, and you will get an additional 15% off any parts or services you need during the year. There is also now an Enhanced Comfort Club which has additional benefits including free service fees for the entire year, extra free drain line clearing and a lifetime T-Stat warranty.

Rosenberg Indoor Comfort proudly serves San Antonio, TX and the surrounding areas. If you live in this area and want to get the most out of your HVAC system and save money, too, give us a call today so you can start saving in comfort.
